entropy.construct: Contextual entropy (Hc): thrash / failed tools / saturated context
entropy.telemetry: Agent token use + failed/total tool calls, or qualitative thrash notes
entropy.confidence_rule: high if tokens+tools observed; low if imputed

opacity.construct: Change opacity (O): hard-to-review footprint of the deliverable
opacity.telemetry: Diff/patch size, spread, complexity — any VCS or change manifest
opacity.missing_behavior: Impute from file/count alone if available
opacity.confidence_rule: high with full change stats; medium with size only

blast_radius.construct: Blast radius (Cb): how widely a mistake can propagate
blast_radius.telemetry: Dependency/impact reach, or declared shared/public/prod surface
blast_radius.normalization: impacted / total when graph exists; else declared [0,1]
blast_radius.missing_behavior: Declare missing; do not invent coupling
blast_radius.confidence_rule: high with graph; medium with declared blast; none if absent

spec_ambiguity.telemetry: Plan disagreement, or raw vs refined task contract
spec_ambiguity.missing_behavior: Use raw/refined proxy at medium confidence
spec_ambiguity.confidence_rule: high with multi-plan similarity; medium with label/proxy

instruction_drift.construct: Deviation from pinned acceptance criteria over long context
instruction_drift.telemetry: AC-vs-diff divergence across checkpoints; plan-adherence audits
instruction_drift.normalization: to be defined at formula revision
instruction_drift.missing_behavior: not in D(t); collect telemetry only

tool_misuse_rate.construct: Malformed or repeated no-progress tool calls
tool_misuse_rate.telemetry: Invalid invocation count / repeated identical failing calls
tool_misuse_rate.normalization: to be defined at formula revision
tool_misuse_rate.missing_behavior: not in D(t); collect telemetry only

goal_misalignment.construct: Pursuing the wrong objective despite locally valid steps
goal_misalignment.normalization: to be defined at formula revision
goal_misalignment.missing_behavior: not in D(t); collect telemetry only
